summary: nature-skills is a pack of agent skills for research writing, citations, and figures, with install notes for Claude Code and Codex. The README describes a web version whose core tools are paper polishing and scientific drawing. It is not a repository from the journal Nature. Apache-2.0. The default branch changed on 2 November. whyItMatters: Use a single skill when you want an agent to revise a paragraph, a citation, or a figure in a documented style, and you can check the result against the source. A style skill does not make a claim true. The README also advertises paid GPT and Claude account services. Read that section before you install, and do not treat the name as the journal's.
